artifact_meaning: A derived, deterministic, mechanically-reordered EXECUTABLE representation of the SAME structural state certified in V2. NOT a new capture, NOT a re-audit, NOT a canonical schema declaration, NOT migration zero. Local artifact only.
derivation_method: Programmatic parse of the frozen v2.sql into typed statement objects (CREATE TABLE / ALTER TABLE ADD CONSTRAINT [classified PK|UNIQUE|CHECK|FK] / CREATE [UNIQUE] INDEX / CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION / CREATE [CONSTRAINT] TRIGGER / INSERT), verified by statement-count cross-checks (grep-independent recount matched the parser's own counts exactly) and a paren-balance + dollar-quote-parity sanity check on the emitted SQL. NOT hand-retyped -- every byte of every unchanged object was extracted programmatically from the source file to eliminate transcription risk.

disclosed_content_changes.change: clientes.id gains inline 'GENERATED BY DEFAULT AS IDENTITY (START WITH 1 INCREMENT BY 1 MINVALUE 1 MAXVALUE 9223372036854775807 CACHE 1 NO CYCLE)' in the Pass-A CREATE TABLE statement.
disclosed_content_changes.why_allowed: V2's own SQL already specified this exact clause verbatim, but only as a COMMENTED-OUT note (SECTION 8), never as live SQL, because expressing it as a live ALTER at that point in V2's file would itself have required clientes to already exist. V2's own comment explicitly prescribes this exact inline form for 'a fresh from-scratch build' -- which is precisely what V3 is. This is applying V2's own already-disclosed, already-fully-specified correction, not inventing new semantics.

disclosed_content_changes.change: 8 CREATE UNIQUE INDEX statements elided (auth_actors_ws_actor_key, business_days_business_date_uq, ladieci_schema_migrations_apply_order_uq, restaurant_tables_workspace_number_uq, service_closeout_snapshots_correlation_uq, service_closeouts_correlation_uq, service_closeouts_session_uq, workspaces_slug_key).
disclosed_content_changes.why_allowed: Each is a byte-for-byte duplicate (same table, same columns, same plain btree, no WHERE clause) of an index Postgres ALREADY auto-creates when its same-named ADD CONSTRAINT ... UNIQUE runs. Running both statements literally would fail with 'relation already exists' on the second one -- this was a genuine, previously-undisclosed executability defect in V2's SQL (not a miscount; V2's own catalog crosscheck of index COUNTS was correct, this is a representation-duplication issue within the reconstructable-DDL text, a different axis). The physical index still exists exactly once per name, created via the constraint. Verified for all 8: identical table+columns+index type, confirmed via direct text comparison before eliding, not assumed.
disclosed_content_changes.mechanism: via the same-named ADD CONSTRAINT ... UNIQUE, which Postgres backs with an implicit unique index of the same name

true_object_counts_vs_task_spec_note: This task's own PASS CRITERIA text says 'all 34 required functions represented'. Direct re-parse of the frozen v2.sql found 37 real CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION statements with full bodies (not 34, not 26). Tracing the discrepancy: V2's own metadata.json has a summary scalar field counts.full_required_function_count=34 that never actually matched V2's own correctly-enumerated 37-name list already present in v2.inventory.json's f10_relevant_functions_full_body_captured array -- a manual-counting bug in one JSON scalar field, not a gap in what was captured. V3 represents the true, programmatically-verified count (37) and includes all 37 real function bodies. Dropping 3 to artificially match 34 would mean omitting real, already-captured, already-certified function bodies -- not permitted under this task's own 'V3 MUST NOT change... function bodies' rule (omission is a form of change).
rls_policies_grants_scope_note: V2's own .sql file never emitted ENABLE ROW LEVEL SECURITY, CREATE POLICY, or GRANT as executable statements -- these facts were recorded only in V2's metadata.json/inventory.json prose, never as live DDL in the .sql artifact this task's FROZEN V2 INPUT section pins by hash. V3 therefore also contains none of these as executable SQL (fabricating new CREATE POLICY statements not present in the hash-pinned source file would violate input purity, even though the underlying facts are known from JSON). This has zero functional effect on F-10 CI: the F-10 test role (f10_ci_runtime, see f10-ci-role-model.json) is BYPASSRLS, so RLS enablement state is inert for F-10's own certification scenarios regardless.
